feeds.title: Deso Novel
feeds.description: Find articles with reviews of Visual Novel Eroge, Galge, Romance, Action, Fantasy, RPG, Horror And Many More. The blog is published by Anime Lovers who like new things about Japan, Visual Novels, Anime and Military.

feeds.title: VNDB Review Blog
feeds.description: The VNDB Review blog is a personal site where the writer talks about visual novels they have played. They often review old or lesser-known Japanese visual novels and give their honest opinion about the story, art, and gameplay.

feeds.title: Blerdy Otome
feeds.description: Blerdy Otome is an otome games and visual novel review site that runs on Black Girl Magic and Dreams. While I mostly focus on romance-themed games, I've been known to cover a wide range of nerdy and otaku-themed topics.

feeds.title: Elsword, Visual Novels and Media
feeds.description: I made this little site/blog thing to have somewhere to put my visual novel reviews, what I'm reading, playing, etc. I'm mostly a software developer but I get pushed to do other work if they need extra guys.

feeds.title: Samantha Lienhard
feeds.description: Fresh video game news and reviews, brought to you by fiction writer Samantha Lienhard. Samantha mainly writes horror and fantasy, but has been known to dabble in all sorts of genres.

feeds.title: English Otome Games
feeds.description: Keeping you updated on the latest in English otome games!Here you'll find information about traditional visual novel style GxB otome games, joseimuke with a female protagonist, games based on shoujo anime, RPGs with romance elements, as well as GxG games made for a female audience.

feeds.title: Kawaii Janakya Dame nano! » Visual Novel
feeds.description: Read to the point reviews of author's favorite visual novels in this section. Welcome to 'Kawaii Janakya Dame nano!' This originally started out as a Pangya blog which spread out into a general foreign mmo blog, which then had some otome games added on to it and before I knew I was blogging about every game I was playing.

feeds.title: Zettai Renai
feeds.description: Hello & welcome to Zettai Renai. This blog was started back in 2015 for me to write down my ramblings about otome games and drama CDs, however, I started to expand into other kinds of visual novels. The purpose of this blog is to provide reviews/impressions of both VNs and Drama CDs.

feeds.title: Otome Adventures
feeds.description: This is supposed to be various thoughts/reviews of otome games I've played or to be played. My name is Theresa. I'm from Canada and I'm striving to become a voice actress. I love playing video games of all sorts and reading different manga.

feeds.title: Meagan Trott Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog to follow the Visual Novel of the author with its character as they are created. Meagan Trott is a game developer, artist, and illustrator based in the SF Bay Area. Though she mostly works digitally nowadays, she's an oil painter at heart who loves creating lush, fantastical scenes.

feeds.title: Sekai Project
feeds.description: Sekai Project is the leading Visual Novel Publisher in the U.S. We are dedicated to bringing the best from the East to the West. Started in 2013, we were a small group of fans who wanted to bring over our favorite visual novels from Japan to the rest of the world.

feeds.title: The Almighty Backlog
feeds.description: The Almighty Backlog is a laid-back gaming blog that reviews video games. Among its eclectic mix of titles, the author has gradually found a niche in exploring visual novels and narrative-driven indie games, offering deeply reflective, emotionally resonant critiques.

feeds.title: Part-Time Storier
feeds.description: Part‑Time Storier is a blog run by Jane Titor. She writes about short visual novels, especially small indie games.

feeds.title: Arimia
feeds.description: Arimia runs a blog at arimiadev.com focused on visual novel development, marketing, and game preservation.

feeds.title: Gosatsu
feeds.description: Gosatsu VNs is the indie developer behind narrative-driven murder mystery visual novels. They publish regular weekly developer blog posts on their official site.

feeds.title: Fuwanovel
feeds.description: Fuwanovel is a well-established web magazine and community hub dedicated to popularizing visual novels in the West. The site features an active blog section covering topics like news, game reviews, translation status updates, interviews, and development roundups.

feeds.title: NookGaming » Visual Novel
feeds.description: Check out our many Reviews, Guides, Walkthroughs, and other articles about visual novels for PC and console.

feeds.title: Noisy Pixel News » Visual Novel
feeds.description: Noisy Pixel is a vibrant gaming website created by passionate gamers and writers, delivering authentic commentary and insights from lived experience in the gaming industry. Under its Visual Novel News section, Noisy Pixel shares regular updates on upcoming releases, development stories, console and PC ports, and localization patches.

feeds.title: The Arcana Game
feeds.description: Find more about the story of Arcana as it progresses. The Arcana is a fantasy/romance visual novel for iOS & Android. You, the player, are an apprentice magician with a gift for fortune-telling. Left in possession of an unusually enchanted Tarot deck, you must navigate intrigue, murder, magic... and perhaps a few saucy encounters.

feeds.title: Two And A Half Studios Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog to know more about their visual novels - Divine Speaker & Beyond the Abyss, gameplay, coding and development, etc. Two And A Half Studios are visual novel developers.

feeds.title: Otome Land
feeds.description: This blog is basically just me writing my opinions about otome games, sharing my experiences and trying to make some friends through this amazing hobby. My name's Ilaria, I'm Italian and I've been playing otome games since 2013.

feeds.title: Woodsy Studio Blog
feeds.description: Read more about our stories and visual novels in the blog. Woodsy Studio develops visual novels and adventure games with a focus on complex characters and quality storylines.

feeds.title: Twentyninenights's Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog where I post any stuffs I like. Mainly, it's involve games and anime. Read my reviews on visual novels I liked and would recommend along with few I didn't.

feeds.title: Play Me Like You Love Me
feeds.description: The development blog of the visual novel 'Play me like you love me'. PMLYLM is a matchmaking game, where you have to help other characters to impress their crush.

feeds.title: Visual Novel Reviews
feeds.description: Website dedicated to reviewing the latest visual novels, creating walkthroughs and sharing game news. I began my first blog as a hobby on blogspot purely to write down my thoughts, opinions, rants or raves on the Visual Novels that I played. Due to the unexpected popularity, I then became sponsored/endorsed by a game review website to regularly compose content for their website.

feeds.title: Why is being a Zodi so bad
feeds.description: Read my reviews on visual novels. This blog is a deconstruction of eroge.

feeds.title: Somnova Studios
feeds.description: Somnova Studios is a group of individuals working on meaningful visual novels for people to enjoy.

feeds.title: Moe-Blog
feeds.description: Moe‑blog is a personal WordPress site by Yoomi, devoted to translations, walkthroughs, reviews, and story summaries mostly centered on visual novels and fan content.

feeds.title: VisualNovels.com
feeds.description: VisualNovels.com is an English-language web magazine that has been publishing reviews, news, guides, and feature articles about visual novels.

feeds.title: Steamberry Studio
feeds.description: Development blog for Steamberry Studio, a visual novel developer. Here, we will post images, snippets and updates related to our projects.

feeds.title: Navigame
feeds.description: Navigame is a two-girl indie game dev team made up of Nellie and Aro. We love making visual novels and otome games!
